text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Is there a giant magnet hidden inside the Earth? Deep down, the outer core is an ocean of liquid iron. Left alone, a field there would fade away within tens of thousands of years. Yet Earth's field is several billion years old. So the moving iron must keep making it, all the time.
